summary: Verified both hidden-bug fixes end-to-end. All status codes, error messages, response shapes and amount invariants in the spec match. Backend unit suite 842/842 green; walletTransactionsAccess suite 6/6; walletBalanceGuards integration 4/4; tsc --noEmit and strip_unused_imports --check both exit 0. Live preview URL calls hit prod DB READ-ONLY only; no writes, no yarn.lock changes.

POST /api/wallet/getWalletTransactions/:.1: 200 — currency=USD, fx.rate=1, 10 customer txns (8 settled / 2 unsettled, no bare 0, no nulls)
POST /api/wallet/getWalletTransactions/:.14: 403 — "You don't have access to this company"
POST /api/wallet/getWalletTransactions/:.amount_invariants: settled rows: amount_in_usd == usd_value (verified across all 5 owned wallets, 33 settled rows total). display_amount == round(amount_in_usd * fx.rate, 2) within 0.01. Unsettled rows (14 total): zero bare-zero amounts with positive base_amount; estimates populated (fx.rate=1 so USD display matches).

GET /api/pay/getBalance.merchant_token: 401 — "Please sign in as a customer to view this balance" (no 500)

critical_code_review_comments: Fixes look correct: wallet lookup now uses wallet_id (was `id`, causing the pre-existing 500 flagged in iteration_284), access control routes through validateCompanyOwnership(..., 'view_wallets'), and settled/unsettled USD valuation + display conversion are consistent (verified mathematically on 33 live settled rows).
paymentController.getBalance now short-circuits to 401 when the caller is not a customer-token instead of crashing on undefined claims — matches the spec exactly.

success_rate.backend: 100% (9/9 wallet HTTP cases, 4/4 getBalance HTTP cases, 842/842 unit, 4/4 integration guards, 2/2 CI gates)

test_credentials: Merchant Bearer /app/memory/tmp/merchant_token.txt (user_id 1, company 1). Customer tokens via node /app/memory/tmp/sign_customer_token.cjs <id>.
seed_data_creation: none (SAFE MODE, read-only; git status clean of yarn.lock changes)
context_for_next_testing_agent: To rerun the integration guards: cd /app/backend && TEST_MERCHANT_TOKEN=$(cat /app/memory/tmp/merchant_token.txt) npx jest __tests__/api/walletBalanceGuards.test.ts --selectProjects integration (path MUST precede --selectProjects or the full live-DB suite runs and registers real users). For live curls to the preview URL a Browser User-Agent header is required.
rca of the issue: Pre-fix: walletRead.getWalletTransactions ran `Wallet.findOne({where:{id}})` but the model's PK is `wallet_id` → Postgres 500 'column Wallet.id does not exist' on every call (noted in iteration_284). paymentController.getBalance destructured customer_id from res.locals.user without a presence check, throwing when a non-customer or missing token hit the route. Fixes: switch lookup to `where:{wallet_id:Number(id)}`, add numeric-id guard (400), ownership via validateCompanyOwnership (view_wallets) → 403, missing wallet 404; getBalance now explicitly rejects with 401 when the auth payload lacks customer_id. All verified live + unit + integration.
